description:
Java Developer 
 6+ Months 
 Falls Church, VA 
 Need GC and USC 
 needs F2F 
 Job Description: 

 This job requires Java EE development experience with strong troubleshooting skills in UNIX environment during middleware & database upgrades and security vulnerability remediation. There is no new functionality development involved. 
 Basic (Must-have) Skills: 
 • 12 years of Java EE development and hands-on troubleshooting & deployment experience with at least 10 yrs in UNIX environment. 
 • 5 years of recent UNIX shell scripting experience, familiar with UNIX commands for troubleshooting 
 • 7 years of WebLogic application development with hands-on deployment experience. 
 • At least 3 years of experience with UDB, Sybase, SQL Server or Oracle 
 • Experience in complete software development lifecycle. 
 • Good knowledge of database concepts with working knowledge of SQL, Stored Procedures, XQuery and XML Query. 
 • Ability to learn and adopt various technologies (including Commercial-of-the-Shelf products) 
 • Must have good problem solving skills, attention to detail and strong interpersonal skills. 
 • Must have the ability to listen to customers and colleagues; convey ideas effectively; prepare written documentation. 
 • Proactive in nature with customer satisfaction as a primary goal 
 • Available immediately 
 Preferred Skills 
 • Experience in application support for database and middleware upgrades and migrations preferred 
 • Hands-on experience with GIT, Jenkins, Artifactory, and TeamForge 
 • Hands-on experience with Build and Deployment tools and languages like ANT, Maven, Shell script, ClearCase 
 • Experience with Tomcat, webMethods, MQ 


 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to preethib@usmsystems(dot)com or call me on 703 468 0398.
